pairing.heading: Pair with HomeKit
pairing.step1: Open the Home app on your iPhone.
pairing.step3: Scan the QR code, or choose More options and enter the code.
pairing.alreadyPaired: This bridge is already paired. You only need the code to pair again, after you have removed the bridge from the Home app.
pairing.notStarted: The bridge has not started yet.
pairing.loadFailed: Could not load the pairing details.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Choose which devices are visible in HomeKit
devices.noFilterText: Choose Active, Inactive or Not supported to see devices.
devices.noResultsText: Change the search term or the selected filters.

bridgeName.title: Name
bridgeName.intro: This is the name of the bridge in HomeKit. A new name restarts the bridge briefly.

pincode.title: Pincode
pincode.intro: You need this code to pair the bridge with the Home app. It is chosen randomly on first start and stays the same afterwards. You can set your own code or generate a new random one. Existing pairings keep working.
pincode.help: Eight digits. HomeKit rejects simple codes, such as 111-11-111 and 123-45-678.

startup.title: Startup
startup.intro: Wait a moment after the app starts before the bridge starts, so Homey can load all devices first.
startup.help: A change applies the next time the app starts.
startup.invalid: Choose a delay between 1 and 600 seconds

errors.bridge_name_too_long: The name can be at most 64 characters
errors.startup_delay_out_of_range: Choose a delay between 1 and 600 seconds
errors.pincode_invalid_format: A pincode consists of eight digits
errors.pincode_too_simple: HomeKit does not accept this code, choose a less simple code
